detail.command:
set -euo pipefail
node -e '
const fs=require("fs");
const p="package.json";
const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8"));
j.type="module";
fs.writeFileSync(p, JSON.stringify(j,null,2)+"\n");
'

# smoke: start server, hit /health, stop
npm run start -w @msngr/server &
PID=$!
cleanup() { kill $PID 2>/dev/null || true; wait $PID 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  if curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:3000/health >/tmp/msngr-health.json; then
    break
  fi
  sleep 0.2
done
cat /tmp/msngr-health.json
echo
grep -q '"ok":true' /tmp/msngr-health.json
echo OK_SMOKE
test -f package-lock.json && echo HAS_LOCK
git status --short | head -80
